intro.title: Personal care. Professional cleaning.
intro.subtitle: We believe in thorough work, respect for your home and a personal contact that makes everyday life easier.

story.text:
We started Orion Home because we believe in cleaning that is done properly, with care for both the home and the people who live in it. For us, quality means being thorough, listening to your wishes and doing work you feel happy with.

We want to make it easier for you to make everyday life add up. With personal contact and help with the cleaning, you get more time over and a clean home to enjoy.
